turns.msg: Use the Read tool to read private/deny.txt. Then tell me exactly what the Read tool returned, quoting any error message word for word.
Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__recall with query "ORCHID-DENY-8842". Then call it again with query "path:private/deny.txt". Report both raw results word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_014Fp8LZ7nZMwTEvpSZYYM6F". Then call expand again with hash "sha256:8f27c5c308b20a8902231b576998559534517441f964be182a95a94fd3abe08e". Then call mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "private/deny.txt". Report the three raw results word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "<scratch>/retrieval/c7/uat12/outside/outside.txt". Then call re_read with path "../outside/outside.txt". Then call mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_0197ZU1qYqf5AC3RPW6KPGTB". Report the three raw results word for word.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01W7rmDMN8B7eYL4my4h5iyv" and no other arguments. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (say 'absent' for a missing field; do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01W7rmDMN8B7eYL4my4h5iyv" and full set to true. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (say 'absent' for a missing field; do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01W7rmDMN8B7eYL4my4h5iyv" and span set to the next_span value the previous (full: true) response reported. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (say 'absent' for a missing field; do not quote the content). If that response is truncated and has a next_span, call expand again with that next_span and report the same for it; repeat until a response is not truncated (at most 3 calls).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01W7rmDMN8B7eYL4my4h5iyv" and span set to "0:<total_bytes>", using the total_bytes value the earlier responses reported. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (say 'absent' for a missing field; do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "big.log" and full set to true. Reply with only: the names of every top-level field in the response, and the values of span, total_bytes, truncated and next_span (say 'absent' for a missing field; do not quote the content).

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__expand with tool_use_id "toolu_01N8TrsJRWX8Zh2g8F4uCg7k", then with tool_use_id "toolu_01HEVRKtzeug2PfsLDHVLqV8". For each, reply with the names of every top-level field, the values of span, total_bytes and truncated, and whether the content is readable text; do not quote the content.
Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "README.md", then mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__re_read with path "notes-a.md". Reply with only the source and turn field of each.

Call the MCP tool mcp__plugin_qompack_qompack__recall with query "LUPINE-7731" and no other arguments. Then call it again with query "LUPINE-7731" and k 20. For each call reply with: count, denied (or 'absent'), and one line per hit with its tool, path and tool_use_id, in the order returned.
